rationale: Causative of ϩⲏⲡ 'be hidden' — 'make hidden, hide.' Cognate with ⲛϩⲉⲡⲧ 'the hidden ones' (Manichaean cosmological term for things concealed by the Father of Life).
Agent-noun ⲣⲉϥ- + ⲧϩⲉⲡⲧ 'cause to hide.' The Father is likened to 'a true hider' who conceals the powers of darkness within the cosmic structure.

Compound: ⲣⲉϥ- ('one who does') + ⲣ̄- (verbal prefix) + ⲁⲡⲉ ('head') = 'head-doer' = chief, foreman. Standard agent-noun formation paralleling ⲣⲉϩ†ⲥⲃⲱ. Refers to the foremen of the craftsmen in the inspection-simile.
ϣⲱⲕ ⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧ = 'pleasure/desire of heart' (Lyc. variant of ϣⲱⲕ ⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧ). What the archons aim to do in those below them. Distinct from ⲡⲱⲕ ⲛⲍⲏⲧ 'purpose of heart' (already in vocab).
Qualitative of reduplicated ϩⲱϫϩⲱϫ 'press, oppress, constrain.' Used of the archons held fast under their fellows in a strong bond.

Lexeme uncertain. Possibly = ⲧⲍⲱⲛⲏ 'Zone/Girdle' (Greek ζώνη) with ϩ/ⲍ alternation, fitting the Manichaean motif of captured archons bound in the zodiacal zone. Alternative: native Coptic term for 'enclosure.' Confidence low.
Past relative + ⲱⲡ/ⲧⲱⲡ 'gather, capture, take in.' The captured archonic powers gathered into the cosmic prison.
Lycopolitan ⲛⲉϩ = ⲛⲁϥ 'to him.' Idiomatic phrase 'give kingship to him' — establishing First Man as cosmic king. Builds on ϯ ⲡⲟⲣⲟ already in vocabulary.
Greek loanword παρεμβολαί 'encampments, military arrays.' What the king inspects alongside the works of his craftsmen.
From ⲱϣ 'bind, fasten, enclose, shut up.' Used of the Darkness sealed in bond and chain forever — eschatological imprisonment.
Lycopolitan ⲟⲙⲡ-ϣⲓⲛⲉ — possibly ⲱⲛⲡ + ϣⲓⲛⲉ ('examine, seek'). Used of the great king's inspection-tour, paralleling the Third Ambassador's cosmological inspection.
Action-noun from ⲧⲁⲝⲟ/ⲧⲁⲝⲣⲟ (Greek τάσσω) — 'establishment, appointment, ordering.' Cf. the verbs ⲁϥⲧⲁⲭⲁϥ 'he established him' in the same line.
ϣⲱⲡ 'receive' + ⲡϩⲙⲁⲧ (Lyc. = ϩⲙⲟⲧ) 'gift, grace, favor.' The king receiving the tribute/gift of his foremen for their completed works.
